ref.description: The reference a `requests send --ref` was given.

Advice.description:
One advice entry: a level, a short kebab-case `type` for programs to match
on, a message, and optionally the one command that follows it up.

command.description: The command that acts on this advice, if any.

message.description: One line for people. For `next`, the command itself.

AdviceLevel.description: How much an advice entry matters.

oneOf.description: Something to know or do next.
Something failed (a gate, a partial batch).

ErrorBody.description: The value under `error` in an error envelope. Published by `teapot schema`.

Exit.description: Exit code: 0 success, 1 usage, 2 system, 3 gate failed, 4 refused.

schema.name: requests.lookup

Advice.description:
One advice entry: a level, a short kebab-case `type` for programs to match
on, a message, and optionally the one command that follows it up.

command.description: The command that acts on this advice, if any.

message.description: One line for people. For `next`, the command itself.

AdviceLevel.description: How much an advice entry matters.

oneOf.description: Something to know or do next.
Something failed (a gate, a partial batch).

LookupAccounting.description:
What a referenced send was charged, verified against the hallpass ledger
at lookup time (bn-6e58).

established.description:
True only when every debit the send recorded has exactly one
matching receipt in the ledger with the same sequence, digest and
amount, the ledger holds no debit of the send that the record lacks,
and the record is final. False means the charge is NOT established:
do not take `units.charged` as the send's cost; `why` says what is
missing.

message.description: One sentence: what the ledger shows.

pass.description: The pass the debits were made against; null when none.

why.description:
The reason when not established: `no-pass` (the project had no pass:
nothing was charged), `not-metered` (the pass sets no `requests`
ceiling: nothing was charged), `not-dedicated` (the send's units
were not recorded per reference), `receipt-error` (the pass, its
ledger or the witness could not be checked), `receipt-ambiguous`
(a reference occurs more than once), `receipt-absent` (a recorded
debit is not in the ledger), `digest-differs`, `charge-differs` (the
receipt's sequence, counter or amount differs from the record),
`record-incomplete` (the send has no recorded end, or the ledger
holds a debit of it the record lacks). Null when established.

LookupCharge.description:
One hallpass debit of a referenced send, checked against the ledger
(bn-6e58).

amount.description:
Units debited: as recorded, or the receipt's when the send's record
did not get to name it; null when unknown.

digest.description: The pass digest of the debit; null when unknown.

hop.description:
The request it paid for: 0 for the first, then one more for each
request after it, in the order sent (redirect hops, the retry after
a login).

matches.description: The ledger sequences of the matching receipts (at most 64).

receipt.description:
What hallpass's receipts say of the reference: `found` (exactly one
debit), `absent` (none in the ledger's history), `ambiguous` (more
than one) or `error` (the pass, the ledger or the witness could not
be checked).

receipt_amount.description:
The `requests` units the receipt shows for this debit, when it is
found once with a single `requests` charge; null otherwise (absent,
ambiguous, unreadable, another counter or several charges).
`units.charged` is the sum of these.

recorded.description:
True when the send's record names this debit; false when only the
ledger shows it (the record was cut short after hallpass recorded
it).

reference.description:
The hallpass caller reference: `teapot/<project-id>/<REF>` for hop
0, `teapot/<project-id>/<REF>/<hop>` after it (`#` and the SHA-256 of
REF in place of a REF longer than 84 bytes).

sequence.description:
The ledger sequence: as recorded, or the receipt's when the send's
record did not get to name it; null when unknown.

target.description:
The target hallpass recorded with it (`ADDR:PORT/PROTO`); null when
none was (the destination was a host name).

LookupEvidence.description: What the project holds about a referenced send.

dial.description:
`not-started` (nothing was dialled), `may-have-started` (admitted,
and no flow shows a connection), `started` (a connection was made or
tried).

dispatching_at.description: When it was admitted; null when it never was.

ended_at.description:
When it was refused, completed or failed; null when none was
recorded.

engine.description: The engine instance that held the send.

engine_running.description:
True when that engine instance is the one running for the project
now.

last_recorded.description:
The last transition recorded: `recorded` (before admission),
`dispatching` (admitted; the dial may have started), `refused`,
`completed` or `failed`.

units_admitted.description: Units of the request ceiling it was admitted for (0 or 1).

LookupFlow.description: One flow of a referenced send.

hop.description:
Its place in the send: 0 for the first request, 1 for the first
redirect hop, ...; null when the completed record does not name it
and it is known only by its tag (a send cut short; or, when the
answer was logged-out and the request was sent once more after a
login, the first try: the record names the retry's hops).

outcome.description:
What the send recorded for that hop: `complete`, `unknown` (bytes
were written and no complete response came) or `stopped`; null when
the send did not get as far as recording it.

present.description: False when the flow is no longer in the store (deleted).

source.description:
How it is known: `record` (the completed send named it) or `tag`
(the flow carries `send-ref:REF`; what a send cut short left).

state.description:
The flow's state now (`complete`, `interrupted`, `live`); null when
it is not present.

status.description: Its response status; null when there is none.

LookupPass.description: The pass a referenced send's units were debited against (bn-6e58).

digest.description:
The digest the first debit was decided under; null when there was
none.

path.description: The pass file; its ledger is beside it.

charged.description:
Units the ledger charged to the send: the sum of the receipts'
`receipt_amount` over its debits that hallpass's receipts show
exactly once. Never taken from teapot's own row, the pass's totals or
the project's counters; null when a receipt could not be read or is
ambiguous, or a found receipt has no single `requests` amount.

unused.description:
Charged and not used (a debit whose request was never written);
null when either is unknown.

used.description:
Units its requests used (requests that left, or may have left, one
per flow), from the send's record; null while the record does not
say (in progress, or cut short after admission).

SendLookup.description: `requests lookup`: what became of the send with this reference.

accounting.description:
bn-6e58: what the hallpass ledger charged the send, checked against
its receipts now.

evidence.description: Times, units, the dial and the engine.

flows.description:
The flows of the send, first first: the completed send's hops, then
any other flow tagged `send-ref:REF`.

reason.description:
The stable reason of a `refused` send (`out-of-scope`,
`connect-failed`, ...) or a `failed` one (`outcome-unknown`,
`stopped`); null otherwise.

state.description:
`refused` (no byte of the request was written to the target; see
`reason`), `completed` (every hop answered and is in `flows`),
`failed` (admitted and dialled, and the exchange did not complete:
bytes may have reached the target, so do not assume it was not
processed; see `reason` and `flows`), `in-progress` (the running
engine is sending it now) or `uncertain` (the send ended with no end
recorded: its engine stopped, or its caller went away: read
`evidence` and `flows`; teapot does not guess). A reference never
recorded is the error `unknown-ref`, never a state. Every state
exits 0: read this field, not the exit code.

schema.summary: Look up a send by its reference
